Indian Ocean and it is a warm current. Mozambique current 
is also a warm current which fl ows through Mozambique 
channel in the West Indian Ocean. In the 40o to 45o latitudes 
flows the South Indian Ocean current, while Benguela current 
is a cold water current which flows in South Atlantic ocean 
along the west coast of Africa.

is also a warm current which fl ows through Mozambique 
channel in the West हिंद महासागर. In the 40o to 45o latitudes 
flows the South हिंद महासागर current, while Benguela current 
is a cold water current which flows in South अटलांटिक महासागर 
along the west coast of Africa.
